description: Derived clock-sector amplitude bookkeeping (issue 17-3): solar excursion at the Moon, quartic depth bookkeeping, step_76 ambient-excursion transmission, projection bookkeeping

solar_excursion.note: leading term u_sun*(a_M/a_E) = 2.54e-11 cos D; the exact series confirms it to <1%; peak-to-peak ~5.1e-11

interior_response.excursion_transmission_source: TEP step_76 unified-profile ambient-response solve (leaking branch, T ~ 1)
interior_response.note: the quartic potential pins the equilibrium level as rho^{1/3}: the derived interior depth bookkeeping is the cube root of density, not the cube; the phenomenological (rho/rho_T)^3 weighting over-concentrates on the core and is superseded. The S_A factors are depth ratios; the ambient-excursion transmission into interior clocks is measured on the solved profile (step_76) at T ~ 1 on the leaking branch

amplitude_bookkeeping.required_projection: delta_r = (c tau_rt/2) * delta_phi_eff with tau_rt = 2.56 s gives 9.702e-03 m -- the direct clock-projection ceiling; the measured 5.08e-03 m requires the ephemeris-fit transfer map (a fraction ~O(1) of the ceiling), which is the channel-level quantity still to be derived

verdict: The volumetric benchmark's two underived ingredients are superseded by the corpus's master-action machinery: the quartic potential pins the equilibrium interior level as rho^{1/3} (derived exponent 1/3, not 3), supplying the depth bookkeeping S_A^Earth = 0.650, S_A^Moon = 0.550, and the ambient-excursion transmission is measured on the solved unified profile (TEP step_76): real bodies sit on the leaking branch and transmit ambient field excursions ~additively, T_Moon = 0.9969. The admissible clock channel carries the computed solar excursion delta phi_sun = 2.54e-11 cos D (the manuscript's earlier ~5e-11 was the peak-to-peak excursion, not the cos-D coefficient). The force channel remains excluded at ~1e-15 by the canonical pairwise operator. What remains to be derived is the ephemeris-projection map delta_phi -> delta_r: the direct clock-projection ceiling is 9.70e-03 m vs the measured 5.08e-03 m, so the required transfer fraction is order unity -- consistent in order of magnitude, pending the explicit ephemeris-fit map (which also fixes the residual sign through the projection convention).
